Title: Azure Communication Services UI Library available in public preview

Body.Content:
The UI Library provides developers chat and calling UI components and turn-key composites. Whether its an Enterprise building line-of-business apps or an ISV building custom solutions, the UI Library can help developers with faster time-to-market and ongoing maintenance for the communication experiences within their applications. Components are fully open-source and identity agnostic with interoperability into Microsoft Teams.

Get started.

Read the blog.

Learn more.
